obs: Great Lakes Dredge & Dock Co. v. Huffman

"Congress recognized and gave sanction to this practice of federal equity courts by the Act of August 21, 1937... The earlier refusal of federal courts of equity to interfere with the collection of state taxes... and the confirmation of that practice by Congress, have an important bearing"
SAMUELS Et Al. v. MACKELL, DISTRICT ATTORNEY OF QUEENS COUNTY, Et Al.
“This judicial doctrine had been approved by Congress in the then-recent Tax Injunction Act of 1937, 50 Stat. 738, now 28 U. S. C. 1341.”

"We cannot assume that Congress would endorse the standards used in Johnson v. Georgia Highway Express, Inc., 488 F. 2d 714 (CA5 1974), Stanford Daily, Davis, and Swann v. Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education, 66 F. R. D. 483 (WDNC 1975), if fee awards based on market rates were viewed as the kind of windfall profits it expressly intended to prohibit."
